name: Jeff Lindsay
career_history: Sr.Design Phase Manager at M A Mortenson, 12/1997 to present; Estimator at RAS Builders, 5/1992 to 12/1997
education: Bachelor's degree, Construction Management, Colorado State University, 1986 to 1991
biography: Accomplished construction management professional with 23 years’ experience providing proactive design phase services for project owners and design teams. • Translates a vision into a constructible design by managing the design team from project goals and requirements to project completion. • Understands technical and planning attributes of specific building types and provides input into the project’s programming and conceptual design activities. • Coordinates design team members and preconstruction services such as estimating, scheduling, project planning, constructability, and site utilization. • Skilled in communicating complex issues to assure a smooth transition between the design team and the on-site project team.

assessment.note: Ward Search's own judgement, not a researched fact.
